subject: t-sc
title: T.SC.------INT.
description: First of two diagrams in ALT(FT)II-29. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'the solidification of transformational functionalism can be viewed as an important step towards uplifting the basic tone level of existence.' The crossing diagrams how theoretical-science structurally meets intention at the transformational-functionalism scale: T-SC (theoretical science) crossed with INT (intention — the partner-axis's actual intentional working). T-SC sits on the left with the subject-arrow; INT sits at top-center with INFO-CON (information convergence), BIA (bi-aitional), and OBS (observation) anchoring the upper-right margin. C-INFO (composite information) and EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) sit at center-right with INT (a second instance of intention, on the right margin) and AFI (affinity insight) further down. POST (postulation) sits centrally below. FUND-P (fundamental particulars) at lower-left and IF-SPT (infra-spirituality) with PER-DY (perception dynamics) at center-bottom. TECH-DY (technological dynamics) anchors the bottom-left margin. Structural argument: when theoretical-science is crossed with intention, EXP-DY branches from the main line, BIA from the EXP-DY line, INFO-CON and C-INFO from the BIA line, and OBS from the C-INFO line. POST branches from the main line, AFI from the POST line, and the second INT and PER-DY from the AFI line, with IF-SPT branching from the PER-DY line. TECH-DY branches from the main line, with FUND-P branching from the TECH-DY line.
